info.name: QA Portfolio — Fake Store API
info.description: Учебная коллекция для позитивных GET и POST проверок. Fake Store API является демонстрационным сервисом; успешный POST не доказывает постоянное сохранение записи.

exec: pm.test('Response is a non-empty array', function () { pm.expect(products).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; });
pm.test('Products contain expected fields and valid types', function () {
pm.test('Product IDs are unique', function () { const ids = products.map((product) => product.id); pm.expect(new Set(ids).size).to.equal(ids.length); });

body.raw:
{
  "title": "QA Portfolio Test Product",
  "price": 42.5,
  "description": "Temporary product payload for API test practice",
  "image": "https://example.com/qa-portfolio-test-product.png",
  "category": "electronics"
}

exec: const expected = { title: 'QA Portfolio Test Product', price: 42.5, description: 'Temporary product payload for API test practice', image: 'https://example.com/qa-portfolio-test-product.png', category: 'electronics' };
pm.test('Status is an accepted success status (200 or 201)', function () { pm.expect([200, 201]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('Response contains the submitted product fields', function () { pm.expect(createdProduct).to.deep.include(expected); });
pm.test('Response includes a numeric ID', function () { pm.expect(createdProduct).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(createdProduct.id).to.be.a('number'); });
// Demo API response does not prove persistent storage.
